package main

import (
	"fxtime"
	"runtime/interrupt"
)

type dev struct{ n int }

var d dev

func (x *dev) handle(interrupt.Interrupt) { x.n++ }

func onIRQ(interrupt.Interrupt) {}

var m map[string]int

func worker() {}

func main() {
	_ = m["a"]
	go worker()
	fxtime.Sleep(1)
	interrupt.New(1, onIRQ)
	interrupt.New(2, d.handle)
	interrupt.New(3, func(interrupt.Interrupt) {})
	interrupt.New(4, onIRQ)
}

// lookup has no calls of its own: only the compiler's.
func lookup(k string) int { return m[k] }
